questions.text: Which of the following describes better the term “Association” in a UML class diagram?

options.a: An association is a relationship between two classes showing how those classes exchange messages.
options.b: An association is a relationship between two classes showing that depending on the multiplicity between them one of the classes is a more refined version of another.
options.c: An association represents a structural relationship that connects two classes.
options.d: None of the previous statements is correct.

questions.text: Which of the following describes better the term “Specialization” in a UML class diagram?

options.a: A specialization is a relationship between two classes showing how those relate to each other.
options.b: A specialization is a relationship between two classes that indicates that any instance of a subclass is associated to any instance of the super class.
options.c: A specialization is a mechanism in which the subclasses inherit the attributes and associations of the superclass.
options.d: None of the previous statements is correct.
